P.text: In TokenWrapper.sol, the transferFrom implementation emits the ERC-20 Transfer event with msg.sender as the from address instead of the from parameter.
P.evidence_quote: In ``TokenWrapper.sol`` the ``transferFrom`` implementation emits the ERC-20 ``Transfer`` event with ``msg.sender`` as the ``from`` address

I.text: The ERC-20 Transfer event should report the actual owner whose tokens are being moved (the from parameter), per the convention Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value).
I.evidence_quote: The ERC-20 ``Transfer`` event is defined and indexed as ``Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value)``. Emitting ``msg.sender`` instead of the ``from`` parameter violates the ERC-20 event convention and produces incorrect logs.

V.text: The Transfer event is emitted with the wrong sender address (msg.sender, the spender) instead of from (the token owner), corrupting ERC-20 transfer logs and breaking off-chain tooling, UIs, auditing, and compliance.
V.evidence_quote: The `transferFrom` function emits the `Transfer` event with the wrong sender address. Instead of reporting the actual owner whose tokens are being moved, the event reports msg.sender (the spender calling `transferFrom`).
